bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs (audio client re-export), springboard/src/svc.rs (audio module), springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs (player capsule), springboard/src/shell/audiosvc.rs, springboard/src/shell/music/system.rs, springboard/src/media/queue.rs
summary: Apps can play a queue, transport, shuffle, repeat and volume through the audio service client, and the shell shows Now Playing on the lock screen and in Control Center. Apps have no library query API, no media picker, no app-facing remote command handlers and no playlist or rating API; the media library lives inside the Music app. A pure media picker model (springboard/ui/src/media_picker.rs) covers kinds, selection rules and the confirmed choice; no picker view exists yet.

features.note: The transport command wire, play queue order and state event are tested headless in proto/tests/parity_sdk-tests-02.rs; the audio client and the music engine have no test yet. No controller object with playback state notifications for media items, and no system music app handoff.

features.note: the audio service arbitrates which app plays; apps do not register as now-playing sessions
no API for apps to publish content items to the system; the playable content manager is deprecated by Apple
deprecated by Apple; video playback is AVFoundation territory and not a Media Player counterpart

gaps: No app-facing media library: no query, filter, collection or library change API (MPMediaQuery, MPMediaLibrary); the scan lives in springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music/library.rs.
No media picker view for apps. springboard/ui/src/media_picker.rs models the picker (kinds, selection rules, search, confirm), but no SDK widget or shell sheet draws it.

No remote command handlers for apps (MPRemoteCommandCenter); Control Center transport and hardware media keys are not exposed to apps (springboard/src/bare/input.rs:826 notes the media-key remote but does not map it).
No playlist, rating or feedback model in the SDK (MPMediaPlaylist, MPRatingCommand); favourites and playlists are private to the Music app.
No volume slider or output route picker widget for apps (MPVolumeView).
Now Playing fields cannot be set by apps beyond the audio service track; no animated artwork and no language options (MPNowPlayingInfoLanguageOption).
